confidence.rationale: The packet identifies 16 affected baseline items and reconciles all 55 records, but the live official menu disproves several missing-item and variant assignments. The outcome nevertheless remains discrepancy_found because restaurant-associated sources affirm allergens omitted from multiple baseline records.

confirmedFindings: Packet reconciliation covers all 55 baseline records: 22 exact_match/verified, 17 exact_match/accurately_unavailable, 7 exact_match/mismatch, 6 missing_from_source/not_applicable, 2 variant_match/mismatch, and 1 variant_match/accurately_unavailable. The live source shows that these disposition counts require recalculation.
Asparagi and Carciofo are absent from the reopened official menu, while Rhubarb Coffee Cake has been replaced by the seasonal Blueberry Coffee Cake.
Acciughe e Burro explicitly contains anchovies, but its baseline omits finfish.
Toast labels Suppli with gluten, while its baseline contains only milk.
The official menu identifies anchovy dressing in Milanese and Toast affirmatively labels the item with finfish, which the baseline omits.
Both Chocolate Nemesis presentations are described as flourless, materially conflicting with baseline wheat/gluten claims attributed to official ingredients.
The official menu has no comprehensive allergen legend or matrix. The restaurant-linked Toast surface provides only partial item-level allergen labels.
rejectedFindings: Reject Terra's claim that Angel Food Cake, Aventino Tiramisu, and Mascarpone Cheesecake are absent: all three appear by exact name in the official Dessert menu.

Reject Terra's variant-only treatment of Chocolate Nemesis, Cookie Plate, and Gelato e Sorbetto: the official Dessert menu lists all three exact names. Separate Lunch/Dolci entries also list Chocolate Nemesis Cake and Gelato Selection, so both menu contexts coexist.
Do not treat Toast's omission of egg from Aventino Burger as proof that egg is absent; partial vendor labels support affirmative disclosures but not negative allergen conclusions.
Chocolate Chip Cookies having no Toast allergen label does not itself conflict with the baseline wheat/gluten claim, although that claim remains unsupported by a comprehensive official disclosure.
Terra's seven-item allergen-conflict set is therefore overstated and incomplete: some findings rely on omitted partial labels, while the exact Chocolate Nemesis record also requires reconsideration.

additionalEvidence.summary: The official page lists the current meal menus and a separate Dessert menu. It directly confirms Angel Food Cake, Aventino Tiramisu, Mascarpone Cheesecake, Chocolate Nemesis, Cookie Plate, and Gelato e Sorbetto, while also disclosing anchovies, anchovy dressing, and flourless Chocolate Nemesis preparations.

The restaurant-linked ordering page identifies the Bethesda location and affirmatively labels Suppli with gluten and Milanese with finfish; its allergen labeling is partial and cannot establish absent allergens.
The official FAQ confirms the Bethesda identity, links Toast for online ordering, and instructs guests to inform staff about allergies and dietary restrictions.

summary: Uphold discrepancy_found, but substantially amend Terra's reconciliation. The official Dessert menu disproves six missing-or-variant assignments. Confirmed discrepancies remain because affirmative restaurant-associated evidence shows omitted finfish for Acciughe e Burro and Milanese, omitted gluten for Suppli, and flourless Chocolate Nemesis preparations conflicting with baseline wheat/gluten claims.
